parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch knob of the electrical switch, made of durable plastic and designed for manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main control interface, allowing the user to turn the electrical circuit on or off by pressing or rotating it.
parts.Movement_description: It can move or rotate slightly depending on the switch type, enabling electrical contact changes.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the switch, typically made of insulating plastic and mounted on a wall or panel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components, ensuring insulation and safety.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or mounting surface during operation.
